snippet.title: Riley the Roadrunner Build 2 - Full Speed
snippet.description:
Showcase of how fast you can blaze through the first level when you know what you're doing.

Obviously, I do not own the music. I am working with a composer at the moment, but haven't made any original pieces yet. You can find the music I am using below, as well as where I got them:

Metal Harbor 16 Bit Cover
By @JXChip 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9lf0yFlQWXM

Sonic Advance 2 Remastered 3.0 - Sky Canyon Zone - Act 2
By @SuperChaosControl 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IJNo2EczRLk&t=0s

Come on, Again - Mario and Luigi Superstar Saga 16 Bit Cover
uploaded by @JXChip   
https://youtu.be/9rJCjfRvBaM?si=by6dNx9CHik5DFdC

Mega Man X Stage Clear (SFX)
uploaded by @Frygoon 
https://youtu.be/HEIUDi0YHuE?si=dNBkNbelkTe-5gnZ
